brief.en: Shoots spore projectiles at the zombies, but hides when they get too close
brief.zh: 向僵尸发射子弹，但是当僵尸靠近时躲避

description.en: A timid mushroom that shoots spore projectiles at zombies in its lane, but hides when they get too close.
description.zh: 向僵尸发射孢子的胆小的蘑菇，当僵尸靠近身边时躲避起来。

chat.en: "How did I get talked into this? I wish I was at home."
chat.zh: “我当初为什么会被说服站在这里？我现在只想回家啊！”

text.en: stops attacking when zombies appears around
text.zh: 有僵尸在附近时停止攻击
